answers_to_the_managers_question.question: Verify genitive agreement after «Генерация» per plural category with real formatted output.
answers_to_the_managers_question.answer: Correct in all four categories, in all four materials. «Генерация» governs the genitive, so one takes the genitive singular (Генерация 1 изображения / 1 озвучки / 1 звукового эффекта / 1 видео) and few, many and other all take the genitive plural (2/22 изображений, озвучек, звуковых эффектов; видео invariant; 21 and 1 stay singular: Генерация 21 озвучки, 21 звукового эффекта, 21 изображения). The shipped counting-position plural (few → «изображения», ui.chat.attachment_refusal.images_many) is a different construction and is not the right form here; the draft does not copy it.
answers_to_the_managers_question.evidence: report.md §2 table, 64 formatted lines in fmt-run-1.log

observations.detail: A cancelled generation still prints model-layer English: CANCEL_QUEUED_COPY / CANCEL_RUNNING_COPY (image-gen-card-model.ts:217-221) and the template `${batchMaterialTitle(...)} batch stopped.` (image-gen-card.tsx:456). Both are byte-identical on origin/main and this PR does not add them; scripts/i18n/tool-state-copy.test.mjs:42-45 pins the batch sentence as belonging to a later cancel-copy slice. So it does not gate this PR — but under the operator's «NO English anywhere» acceptance a ru user who cancels still reads English there, on every locale. Candidate follow-up key round.
